description_en: Generates a random data key (DK) for local data encryption
description_zh: 生成一个随机的数据密钥，用于本地数据加密
name: GenerateDataKey

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the key. You can also specify the alias or Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the key. For more information about aliases, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html.
When you access a key that belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you must enter the ARN of the key. The ARN of a key is in the `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}` format
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的ID，也可以指定为密钥别名或密钥资源名称（ARN）。关于别名的详细介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html。
访问其他阿里云账号下的密钥时，必须输入密钥ARN。密钥ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`。
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the length of the generated data key (DK). Valid values:

AES_256: a 256-bit symmetric key.

AES_128: a 128-bit symmetric key.

Use KeySpec or NumberOfBytes to specify the length of the data key (DK). If neither parameter is specified, KMS generates a 256-bit data key (DK). If both parameters are specified, KMS ignores the KeySpec parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定生成的数据密钥的长度，取值：

AES_256：256比特的对称密钥。

AES_128：128比特的对称密钥。

建议使用KeySpec或者NumberOfBytes来指定数据密钥长度。如果两者都不指定，KMS生成256比特的数据密钥；如果两者都被指定，KMS会忽略KeySpec参数
parameters.name: key_spec

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the length of the generated data key (DK) in bytes.

Valid values: 1 to 1024.

Default value:
If KeySpec is set to AES_256, the default value is 32.
If KeySpec is set to AES_128, the default value is 16
parameters.help_zh:
指定生成的数据密钥的长度，单位为字节。

取值：1~1024。

默认值：
当KeySpec取值为AES_256时，NumberOfBytes默认值为32。
当KeySpec取值为AES_128时，NumberOfBytes默认值为16
parameters.name: number_of_bytes

parameters.help_en:
The JSON string of key-value pairs.

If you specify this parameter, you must provide the same parameter when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28950.html API operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42975.html
parameters.help_zh:
key/value对的JSON字符串。

如果指定了该参数，则在调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28950.html接口时需要提供同样的参数。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42975.html。
parameters.name: encryption_context

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run mode. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

Default value: false.

The dry run mode is used to test API calls, verify whether you have the required permissions on the resources, and check whether the request parameters are correctly configured. After the dry run mode is enabled, KMS always returns a failure and provides the cause of the failure. The causes include:

DryRunOperationError: The request would succeed if the DryRun parameter is not configured.
ValidationError: The specified parameters in the request are invalid.
AccessDeniedError: You do not have the permissions to perform the operation on the KMS resources
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启DryRun模式。

true：开启
false（默认值）：关闭

DryRun模式用于测试API调用，验证您是否具有相应资源的权限，以及请求参数是否配置正确。DryRun模式开启后，KMS会始终返回失败并提示失败原因。失败原因包含如下：

DryRunOperationError：不配置DryRun参数时，请求会成功。
ValidationError：请求中指定的参数有误。
AccessDeniedError：您无权在KMS资源上执行该操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The trusted environment authentication information.

AttestationDocument
// The trusted environment attestation document using Base64 encoding, which includes information such as environment measurements, signatures, and certificates.

KeyEncryptionAlgorithm
// The secret key encryption algorithm. Only RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256 is supported.

Content structure of AttestationDocument:
quoted                  
extendUserData // The user extension data using Base64 encoding. The decoded structure is as follows:
aud // The fixed value "kms". 
iat // The issuance time, which is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
exp // The expire time, which is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
pubKey // The RSA2048 public key in SPKI format using Base64 encoding.
digestAlg // The summary algorithm. Only "sha256" is supported.
ver // The protocol version. Only "v1" is supported.
signature // The report signature, which is used to authenticate the integrity of quoted and extendUserData.
pcrInfo:
pcrValues // The Platform Configuration Register (PCR) measurements.
pcrSelectionOut // The PCR selection information.
pcrUpdateCounter // The number of PCR updates.
cert // The platform attestation certificate, which is used to authenticate the validity of the signature.
<notice>This parameter takes effect only when you invoke the API operation through a dedicated gateway.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
可信环境认证信息

AttestationDocument
// Base64 编码的可信环境证明文档，包含环境测量值、签名及证书等信息

KeyEncryptionAlgorithm
// 密钥加密算法，目前仅支持 RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256

AttestationDocument 内容结构：
quoted                  
extendUserData// 用户扩展数据（Base64 编码），解码后结构如下：
aud // 固定值 "kms" 
iat // 签发时间（秒级 Unix 时间戳）
exp                        // 过期时间（秒级 Unix 时间戳）
    - pubKey                     // RSA2048 公钥（Base64 编码的 SPKI 格式）
    - digestAlg                  // 摘要算法，目前仅支持 "sha256"
    - ver                        // 协议版本，目前仅支持 "v1"
signature                    // 报告签名，用于验证 quoted 与 extendUserData 的完整性
pcrInfo:
pcrValues                  // 平台配置寄存器（PCR）测量值
    - pcrSelectionOut            // PCR 选择信息
    - pcrUpdateCounter           // PCR 更新次数
cert                         // 平台证明证书，用于校验签名的有效性
<notice>仅在调用专属网关的openapi时生效></notice>
parameters.name: recipient

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the data key (DK) is managed and generated by KMS
parameters.help_zh: 是否由KMS托管并生成托管数据密钥
parameters.name: managed_by_kms

parameters.help_en: The name of the managed data key (DK). This parameter is required only when ManagedByKms is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 托管数据密钥名称，仅在ManagedByKMS = true时需要且必填
parameters.name: data_key_name

parameters.help_en: The key material of the managed data key (DK). Specify this parameter only when ManagedByKms is set to true and Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) is used
parameters.help_zh: 托管数据密钥材料，仅在ManagedByKMS = true且采用BYOK时才填写
parameters.name: key_material

CiphertextBlob.description_en: The ciphertext of the data key (DK) encrypted by the primary version of the specified key
CiphertextBlob.description_zh: 数据密钥被指定密钥的主版本加密后的密文

CiphertextForRecipient.description_en:
When the Recipient parameter is passed, the public key encryption of the plaintext data key (DK) is performed by using the pubkey in the extendUserData field of the Recipient parameter, and Base64 encoding is applied.
The public key is the pubkey field in extendUserData.
This parameter takes effect only when you invoke the API operation through a KMS instance gateway.
<notice>This parameter takes effect only when you invoke the API operation through a dedicated gateway.</notice>
CiphertextForRecipient.description_zh:
当传递Recipient时， 使用Recipient中的extendUserData的pubkey公钥加密明文数据密钥，采用Base64进行编码
<notice>仅在调用专属网关的openapi时生效></notice>
CiphertextForRecipient.title_zh:
当传递Recipient时， 使用Recipient中的公钥加密明文数据密钥，采用Base64进行编码
公钥是extendUserData中的pubkey
仅在调用实例网关的openapi时生效
